ATP Synthesis

       1. H+ Gradient
       • Electron transport
         chain pumps H+ from
         mitochondria to inter
         membrane space
       • H+ concentration is
         higher in inter
         membrane space than
         mitochondrial matrix

ATP Synthesis

       2. ATP Synthetase
       • Inner mitochondrial
         membrane is
         selectively permeable
       • H+ can come back to
         matrix through a
         membrane protein
         “ATP Synthetase”
